definitions.explanation: In astronomy, a star of apparent magnitude 1 — one of the brightest stars visible in the night sky. The magnitude system divides visible stars into six classes, with {一等星|いっとうせい} the brightest category regularly taught in schools.

examples.japanese: シリウス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一等星|いっとうせい}だ。
⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一等星|いっとうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いている→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: Several first-magnitude stars are shining in the night sky.

examples.japanese: オリオン⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一等星|いっとうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ふたつ⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: The constellation Orion has two first-magnitude stars, making it very prominent in the winter night sky.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{一等|いっとう}→一等：28091_ittou⟧ ('first class; first rank') and {星|せい} ('star'). The magnitude classification originated with the ancient Greek astronomer Hipparchus and is now part of the standard Japanese elementary-school and middle-school science curriculum.

USAGE:
- Typically used in everyday speech, educational materials, and popular astronomy. Professional astronomers use precise decimal magnitudes instead.
- Worldwide there are about 21 stars classified as {一等星|いっとうせい}. Well-known examples include シリウス (Sirius), ベガ (Vega), アルタイル (Altair), アンタレス (Antares), and ベテルギウス (Betelgeuse).
- Smaller numbers (first class) indicate brighter stars; larger numbers (sixth class) indicate the faintest stars visible to the naked eye.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一等星|いっとうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: a first-magnitude star shines
- {一等星|いっとうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧: to spot a first-magnitude star
- {一等星|いっとうせい}⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧: first-magnitude class (rare)
- ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大三角|だいさんかく}: the Winter Triangle — formed by three first-magnitude stars

RELATED WORDS:
- {二等星|にとうせい}: second-magnitude star — the next category down.
- {六等星|ろくとうせい}: sixth-magnitude star — the faintest category visible to the naked eye.
- ⟦{等級|とうきゅう}→等級：28928_toukyuu⟧: magnitude (astronomical) — the general technical term.
- ⟦{恒星|こうせい}→恒星：13043_kousei⟧: fixed star — the general astronomical term for a star, as opposed to a planet.
